# @sharadox/scroll-web-library

> Smooth scrolling (Lenis) and active-section tracking for React.

- /smooth-scroll: <SmoothScroll duration=1.15 anchorOffset=-60 /> — off with prefers-reduced-motion; handles a[href^="#"] clicks
- /active-section: useActiveSection(ids: readonly string[]) → { active: id at viewport middle, within: 0–1 through it, page: 0–1 page progress }
- Peer: react. License: Sharadox Open Source License 0.1.0
- SmoothScroll also turns plain clicks on links to the current page (same path, no hash or query, no target, no modifier keys) into a scroll to the top, without reloading — with or without reduced motion.
- /glide: glideTo(top, { duration? }) — through the running SmoothScroll (Lenis) or window.scrollTo (smooth, or auto with reduced motion); registerGlider is internal to SmoothScroll
- /scroll-steps: useScrollSteps(sectionRef, count, { duration? = 0.9 }) — while the section is pinned, each wheel gesture (a pause of 180 ms starts a new one) or finger swipe (30 px+) glides exactly one step; step i sits at top + (i + 0.5) / count × (height − innerHeight); past the ends the page scrolls on
- 0.3.0: glide, scroll-steps
